description: The bar chart illustrates the "effect" of six different models across various language families. The horizontal category axis, labeled "family", displays nine groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, a category whose label is obscured by a solid gray rectangle, and Uralic. The vertical value axis, labeled "effect", uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -5 to 35, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 10 and corresponding horizontal grid lines. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing six adjacent bars representing different models as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Every bar is outlined in black and includes a vertical black error bar. The values vary significantly across the language families and models. The highest values are observed in the IE-Indic family, where the mBERT-B₂ bar reaches a maximum of approximately 24, and the XLM-B₂ bar is around 21. Conversely, the lowest value is found in the category with the obscured label, where the mBERT-R₂ bar dips below zero to approximately -2.5. Families like Isolate and Uralic show very small effects, with all bars hovering near 0. In several families, such as IE-Germanic and IE-Slavic, the B₂ models (pink and dark red) and L₂ models (light and dark blue) show higher effects, ranging from roughly 9 to 17, compared to the R₂ models (light and dark green), which remain near 0. The categories do not follow a strict alphabetical order overall, though the "IE-" prefixed families are grouped together, and the only specific visual emphasis is the gray shaded box hiding the eighth category label.
